title: Chapter 210: The Main Combat Force Sets Out
content:
Chapter 210: The Main Combat Force Sets Out

After several days of continuous fighting, the Zerg army has obtained a large amount of resources. Wu Qing mainly used these resources to increase the strength of the Zerg ground main combat forces fighting in the underground world.

The strength of the Zerg Hydralisk has increased to 210,000. Except for 10,000 in the reinforcements supporting the Naga tribe, the remaining 200,000 are all fighting in the underground world.

The Zerg cockroaches fighting in the underground world have a strength of 100,000, the destroyers have a strength of 15,000, and the stealth spiders have a strength of 5,000.

These more than 300,000 Zerg ground main combat forces, with a large number of Zerg puppies, are very powerful!

If Wu Qing had not had other plans and did not want to suffer too much loss, he could have a decisive battle with the ghouls now.

The longer the Zerg fights with the ghouls, the smaller the ghouls' strength advantage will be. In the most recent siege organized by the ghouls, the Zerg army did not retreat, but only resisted with the loss of some Zerg puppies.

If the fight continues like this, the Ghouls will only be able to passively take the beating.

The Zerg's main ground combat troops have increased so many troops, all of which have not been upgraded, so the resources consumed are relatively not much.

The continuous harvest on the three battlefields, plus the Naga tribe sent another batch of luck beads, the system has a lot of gas resources left.

In order to start the fight against the demons as soon as possible, Wu Qing directly consumed 4 million gas resources and added 40,000 Zerg dragons, bringing the total force of the Zerg dragon group to 100,000!

The 100,000 Zerg dragons flying in the air and with super mobility were divided into multiple teams. Under the unified command and dispatch of the Queen of the Bugs, they quickly cleaned up the entire territory of the Bugbears.

The Zerg dragons have extremely high cleaning efficiency, and the Zerg puppies only need to follow behind to occupy the territory.

In less than a day, the Zerg dragons scattered and cleaned up the entire territory of the Bugbears, except for a small number of enemies that Wu Qing prepared to leave for the Alliance Army to fight.

More than a quarter of the land in the entire region was under the control of the Zerg.

Wu Qing withdrew the Zerg dragon group back to the Zerg territory to rest and recover, and the task of controlling the territory was handed over to the Zerg puppies. Now the Zerg did not have enough population, so they could only use the Zerg puppies that could be hatched in unlimited quantities to temporarily control the territory.

These territories will not be developed for the time being.

The bear goblins were completely out of the game. Wu Qing passed the news of the preparations to attack the demons to Naga, and began to prepare the army for tomorrow's expedition according to the plan.

The battle plan formulated by Wu Qing and Naga required the Zerg to send out the main force to defeat the main force of the demons head-on together with the Naga army.

Naga has been mobilizing the army these days and concentrated the Naga's forces on the most important confrontation battlefield.

Naga personally led the most elite troops of the Naga tribe to command.

These intelligences were not hidden, and the demons learned them one by one. Forced by the situation, they could only mobilize their troops synchronously and gather a large number of demon troops to the battlefield selected by the Naga tribe.

The Naga tribe was able to successfully mobilize the demon army because of the combat operations of the Zerg reinforcements.

According to the Naga tribe's plan, the Zerg reinforcements were constantly consuming the demon army, allowing the Naga tribe to mobilize excess troops.

When the Zerg reinforcements captured a demon front castle, the Naga army defending the demon front castle on the opposite side would have no opponents, and these Naga troops would be transferred to the main battlefield.

The more demon troops the Zerg reinforcements destroyed, the more troops the Naga tribe would gather on the main battlefield.

When the Naga troops had an absolute advantage on the main battlefield, the demons would worry that the Naga tribe would take the initiative to start a war, and could only draw troops from other places to come to the main battlefield to maintain a balance of forces.

In this way, the Naga tribe achieved the purpose of mobilizing the demon army to gather and conduct a decisive battle.

Now on the main battlefield, the Naga tribe and the demon tribe have each assembled millions of troops. The demon tribe is fine and does not need too much logistical supply, but the situation of the Naga tribe is a bit bad. The huge logistical supply of millions of troops has brought a lot of trouble.

Therefore, Naga hopes that this battle will start earlier.

The Zerg’s counterattack against the demon tribe in conjunction with the Naga tribe is a good opportunity to show the strength of the Zerg. At that time, in addition to the Naga tribe, the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, the Tengu tribe and some observers from other forces who have received the news will go to watch the battle.

Wu Qing is going to use the strongest army lineup of the Zerg tribe to fight this battle, to show everyone the powerful combat power of the Zerg army, and to pave the way for the Zerg’s subsequent plans.

The Naga tribe is going to fight a big battle between millions of troops for a whole day, so the Zerg army must rush to the battlefield of the Naga tribe in advance to assemble.

Two hundred thousand Zerg Hydralisks, one hundred thousand Zerg Roaches, ten thousand Zerg Destroyers, and five thousand Zerg Stealth Spiders withdrew from the battle in the underground world. These more than three hundred thousand Zerg main ground combat forces will immediately set off for the Naga territory together with a million Zerg Zerglings.

Zerg Hosts and Exploding Swarms will accompany them in the air, and Wu Qing plans to let the Zerg Dragon Group and Zerg Queen fly over early tomorrow morning. They are fast and will be able to reach the battlefield soon.

The Zerg underground world base will be handed over to five thousand Destroyers and a large number of Zerg Zerglings to cooperate with the Zerg's powerful defense system for defense.

The Ghouls are now scared. If the Zerg army does not take the initiative to attack, they generally do not have the courage to counterattack.

Moreover, Wu Qing would not let the ghouls spend an easy night.

The 100,000 Zerg dragons that returned to the Zerg territory to rest and recuperate entered the underground world after recovery, replaced the Zerg ground forces, and launched a fierce air strike on the territory of the ghouls.

The Zerg dragons, using their mobility and flexibility, flew to the hinterland of the ghouls to attack those skeleton blood pools that have not yet strengthened their defense.

These days, the main defense focus of the ghouls has not been attacked by the Zerg air forces. At this time, they suddenly faced the attack of the Zerg dragons and could not adjust.

A large number of skeleton blood pools of the ghouls were destroyed by the Zerg dragons, and the losses were heavy.

Wu Qing planned to let the Zerg dragons fight until the second half of the night, leaving some time for rest and recovery. Tomorrow they will go to the world to declare the powerful force of the Zerg.

…

More than one million Zerg ground troops marched towards the Naga territory in a mighty manner. This is a powerful force that can sweep across this area.

In front of the current Zerg, the demons in this area are already insignificant. The reason why Wu Qing wanted to show the strength of the Zerg in such a high-profile manner is to pave the way for the Zerg to go out.

The Zerg army successfully arrived at the main battlefield selected by the Naga tribe before dark.

This time, the Zerg army was led by Wu Qing's Zerg clone. Naga, who led important Naga people to greet him, finally met Wu Qing.

Although this is Wu Qing's Zerg clone, the consciousness is Wu Qing himself. The body of the Zerg clone is very similar to Wu Qing, and it looks very different from the original body.

When everyone met, they naturally exchanged greetings. Naga and Wu Qing have been in spiritual contact for a long time, and they feel very familiar with each other, without the strangeness of meeting for the first time.

After roughly counting the Zerg reinforcements, Naga, who was already very familiar with the combat power of the various Zerg arms, smiled at Wu Qing and said, "It seems that you don't plan to let our army go on the field again!"

"As long as we can weaken the power of the demons to the greatest extent, we will do our best!"

Wu Qing also responded with a smile.

"I didn't expect you to defeat the bear goblins, who are guarded by a strong army, so quickly. The demons are no problem!"

"You have invested so much power to defeat the evil god camp here. What are your plans for the future?"

Naga can be regarded as a not-so-simple person by the goblins. She is very capable in all aspects.

A large tribe like the Zerg chose to enter the world here and invested such a powerful force regardless of taboos. There must be some plan.

The enemy is about to be defeated. There are only three large tribes in the same camp left. Without external enemies, the next step is internal fighting.

Now the Naga tribe has a good relationship with the Zerg. She chose to have a chat with Wu Qing before the external enemies are completely eliminated.

Wu Qing came here this time, and one of the most important tasks was to personally talk to Naga about the Naga territory.

Naga took the initiative to mention that Wu Qing could just have a chat with Naga before the war, and perhaps this time, two major problems could be solved at once.

"The Zerg's entry channel happened to be opened in this area, and this is a fact that cannot be changed!"

"The Zerg has the protection of the Overlord, and has not felt the threat of the taboo for the time being, so it intends to build this place into a base for the Zerg to enter the outside world!"

"Now the bear goblin tribe has completely withdrawn, and the demon tribe will soon be driven out after tomorrow's battle!"

"In this special area, only you, me and the Tengu tribe are left!"

"We believe that as allies in the same camp, many things can be discussed, and there is no need to confront each other and cause conflicts!"

"The Tengu tribe intends to withdraw, but is high above us and is unwilling to negotiate with us. I will try to use a less exciting way to let them leave decently!"

Wu Qing spoke frankly to Naga, expressing his intention to force the Tengu tribe to leave.

With the current strength of the Zerg, the Tengu tribe's branch in this area is no match at all, unless they disregard taboos and send out a strong army to fight the Zerg to the death.

As long as the Zerg is determined, the Tengu tribe will be forced to withdraw. It is a foregone conclusion. It depends on how they will choose to withdraw in the end.

This is not Wu Qing threatening the Naga tribe, but stating a fact. He believes that Naga can also see it, otherwise she would not take the initiative to talk to him about this matter.

"As for the nobles, with our friendly relationship, everything can be discussed!"

"If you intend to stay here permanently, we won't mind. With the territory of the three tribes, it is enough for the time being!"
